title: Map Territory Wipe
description: US silhouette with NE pin, soft westward territory wipe, and cascade trunk-to-fork arrows. Seek-safe SVG/GSAP; no MP4 wrapper. Inspired by Moving Image Archive, Evolution of the Oil Industry (1934) shot 49 (clip a36b3d33-8c6b-5748-b606-e7841020121f); NARA/FedFlix public domain - not affiliated; code recreation. Fidelity ceilings: painterly topo/grain, soft film ink vs vector outline, diamond flare tips, 8s compress vs longer ref, live-action open/close OOS.
